project_info.tagline: 21 years of genre bending mashup originality
project_info.vibe: Dark & moody nightclub, luxury cinematic with neon accents, no purple gradients.

theme.archetype: Archetype 5 (Luxury) blended with high-contrast nightclub energy.
theme.rationale: Cinematic, moody, and expensive. Needs to feel like stepping into a premium club at 1am, relying on texture, noise, and sharp lighting accents rather than flat generic dark colors.

rules: Use #FF2A4D (Crimson Neon) and #FFB000 (Amber) sparingly for buttons, hover states, and glowing accents.
Backgrounds must use CSS noise/grain overlay for a textured, tactile nightclub feel.

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-black uppercase tracking-tighter
hierarchy.h2: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold uppercase tracking-tight

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous spacing. p-8, p-12, p-24, py-32 for section padding.
layout_and_spacing.grid_strategy: Tetris Bento Grid for portfolio and services. Asymmetric layouts with breathing room.
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Optical alignment. Left-align dense text and headings. Center-align only for massive hero statements.
layout_and_spacing.container: Max-width containers (max-w-7xl) with mx-auto and px-6 md:px-12.

surfaces_and_textures.glassmorphism: Used for sticky header. bg-black/60, backdrop-blur-2xl, border-b border-white/10.
surfaces_and_textures.cards: Dark mode Neumorphism or Grid Borders. Flat surface (#0A0A0A), 1px solid border (border-white/10), no heavy shadows. Add subtle inner glow for premium feel.
surfaces_and_textures.texture: Apply a subtle SVG noise/grain background fixed to the body to kill the digital flatness.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Text colors must explicitly change (e.g., hover:text-white). Cards lift slightly (-translate-y-1) and borders glow with accent color.
motion_and_interactions.buttons: Primary CTA must have high contrast (e.g., bg-[#FF2A4D] text-white). Hover brightens background.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use specific transition properties (transition-colors, transition-transform) with 0.3s ease-out.

header.style: Sticky at top, z-50, Glassmorphism. Logo left, Links center, CTA right.
header.links: About, Services, Portfolio, Testimonials. Hover:text-white transition-colors.

hero.layout: Full screen (min-h-screen). Background image with heavy gradient overlay (bg-gradient-to-t from-[#050505] via-black/50 to-transparent) so image breathes but text is readable.
hero.content: Overline: 'Mobile DJ & Mashup Artist'. H1: 'DJ B-SUAVE'. Subtitle: '21 years of genre bending mashup originality'. Primary CTA: 'Book Now'.

about.layout: 2-column asymmetric grid. Left: Text heavy, story-driven. Right: Mood image.

services.layout: Grid of cards (Weddings, Clubs, Corporate, Private Parties). Use Phosphor icons or Lucide icons. Minimalist cards with 1px border.

portfolio.description: The centerpiece. A Tetris Bento grid showing Instagram embedded videos/reels. Emphasize asymmetric layout. Use dark placeholders or actual iframes for IG embeds.
portfolio.style: Cards with no padding for media, sharp edges or subtle 4px border-radius.

testimonials.layout: Marquee or Carousel of text cards. Minimalist quote design. Large serif quotation marks for contrast.

contact.layout: No form. High-impact typography. 3 massive buttons: WhatsApp, Phone, Email. Use explicit icons.

footer.layout: Massive typography 'DJ B-SUAVE' (text-[10vw]). py-20. Darker than base if possible.

testing.attributes: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid='hero-book-button', data-testid='contact-whatsapp-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the website as a single-page scrolling portfolio using React, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion.
Do NOT use pure black (#000000). Use #050505 or #0A0A0A for backgrounds.
Do NOT use generic purple or teal gradients.
Embed Instagram reels for the portfolio section using HTML iframe embeds or mocked stylized cards if real embeds are not provided.
Ensure the hero image has a proper gradient overlay to maintain text readability (WCAG AA standard).
Implement a CSS noise/grain texture overlay across the entire site to give a tactile, cinematic nightclub feel.
Use Lucide icons for Contact buttons (WhatsApp, Phone, Mail).
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
